author: reek
body: A scope inside another scope is safe to hand over, and working out whether it IS inside needs to know what the scope means.

author: reek
body: `deep-read` reads only under "/config/app/". A parameter declared over "/config/" promises its caller no more than reads under "/config/", and "/config/app/" is under "/config/", so the argument does less than the parameter promised. The argument boundary refused this until the relation existed.

author: reek
body: The relation is chosen by the effect's family, off its own name, exactly as `scope-admits` has always chosen it: a filesystem scope is a path prefix, a network scope an authority, a console scope a channel. It is `scope-subsumes`, and it is deliberately NOT `scope-admits` -- see errors/effect-widen-scope-port for the one clause that separates them and the laundering it would have caused.

author: reek
body: The unsound direction ships beside this as errors/effect-widen-scope-out: a "/config/" argument does NOT pass where "/config/app/" is expected, because it may read things the parameter promised it would not.
